Mouhamed Gueye.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Henri Veesaar.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Devin Carter.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

Tyler Bilodeau.comment: Bilodeau will miss the season opener against the Hornets on Wednesday due to a shoulder sprain, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.

Coby White.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Sunday that White (calf) is without a definitive timetable for a return, though he's been ramping up and taking more contact in practice, Nick Carboni of WCNC Charlotte reports.

Kon Knueppel.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Sunday that Knueppel (hamstring) is still without a timetable for a return, though he's been ramping up and taking more contact in practice, Nick Carboni of WCNC Charlotte reports.

Grayson Allen.comment: Allen (knee) didn't play in Friday's 117-98 preseason loss to the Grizzlies.

Moussa Diabate.comment: Diabate has been ruled out for Friday's preseason finale against the Grizzlies due to a right elbow injury.

Kylan Boswell.comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

Grant Williams.comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

Zach Collins.comment: Collins (toe) is hopeful to play Wednesday against the Raptors, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
